The only module-map prose delta describes immutable Task Outputs in the exact producing answer outcomes, private declaration provenance and unassociated manual/other-turn Outputs; other module descriptions and navigation remain unchanged. Three personal-mode assessment producer tools use existing self-scoped authority; publish/remove are mutating and use exact-answer HTTP authorization/CAS. No operator elevation or unrelated catalog policy changes. Additional exact-turn Output and lineage regressions exercise bounded descriptor reads and cursor filtering; no writer/recovery qualification is inferred.
